summary: RCU callback enqueueing reads rcu_state.n_force_qs while the grace-period kthread increments the same global counter.

call_chain.evidence: Patch hunk changes n_force_qs reads in this function.
KCSAN peer function and bitcode definition present.

interleaving: A CPU enqueues an RCU callback and __call_rcu_core compares rcu_state.n_force_qs with the per-CPU snapshot.
The RCU grace-period kthread concurrently executes rcu_gp_fqs and increments rcu_state.n_force_qs.
The fix marks the global counter reads and increment write with READ_ONCE/WRITE_ONCE.

ground_truth_access.required_ordering: The global force-quiescent-state counter is shared between callback enqueue and grace-period progress code and must use marked accesses.

vulnerability_surface.why_relevant: n_force_qs is the global sequence counter used by callback enqueueing to detect whether a force-quiescent-state scan has progressed.

aliases.name: rcu_state.n_force_qs
aliases.evidence: Global rcu_state field incremented by grace-period force-QS processing.

aliases.name: rcu_state.n_force_qs
aliases.evidence: Callback enqueue core compares the global value to rdp->n_force_qs_snap.

aliases.name: rdp->n_force_qs_snap
aliases.evidence: Per-CPU snapshot stores the global counter value after reading it.

thread_a.evidence: call_rcu calls __call_rcu, which reaches __call_rcu_core on the local rcu_data.

thread_b.evidence: The grace-period loop calls rcu_gp_fqs to force quiescent-state scans.

coverage.analysis_conclusion: The callback enqueue path, grace-period loop, shared global counter, and patch hunks are all in tree.c.

patch_hunks: 2431774f04d1 changes rcu_state.n_force_qs++ to WRITE_ONCE and wraps reads in rcu_do_batch, __call_rcu_core, and rcutree_prepare_cpu with READ_ONCE.
indirect_edges: rcu_gp_kthread drives rcu_gp_fqs_loop, which calls rcu_gp_fqs.
entry_discovery_log: tree.ll defines call_rcu, __call_rcu_core, rcu_gp_fqs_loop, and rcu_gp_fqs.
